s.note: Billy's new foster home in Philadelphia
s.how: Freeze a 400g rib eye for 30 minutes and shave thin. Sear with a sliced onion in oil. Lay 6 slices provolone over to melt, then pile onto 12 toasted slider buns.
Cut 10 corn tortillas into lightning bolt shapes and fry until crisp, then salt. Warm 250ml milk, stir in 200g cheddar and chopped jalapeños until smooth. Shazam.

m.note: dinner around the busy Vasquez family table
m.how: Roll 700g beef mince with breadcrumbs and egg into balls and brown. Simmer 40 minutes in 2 tins tomatoes with garlic. Toss with 500g spaghetti and parmesan. Serve with a baguette baked with garlic butter.

w.note: the Rock of Eternity where Billy meets the wizard
w.how: Melt 400g dark chocolate. Stir through 150g marshmallows, 100g roasted almonds, 100g broken plain sweet biscuits and 30g coconut. Press into a lined tin, chill until set and cut into chunks.

d.how: Heat 1L milk until steaming. Whisk in 150g chopped dark chocolate until frothy. Pour into four mugs, top with 150ml whipped cream and hook a candy cane on each.
